measurement_protocol: Use the fixed formal Scene 02 start placement.
Measure the shortest collision-free path feasible for the robot body.
End at the boundary of the declared 0.5 m valid plant goal region.
Record the measured value, method and operator statement before Standard SPL finalization.
operator_statement: 大概直线距离应该是7m 可以计算standard spl
notes: Applies to any current or future Scene 02 formal episode using the same fixed start/target placement. Only formal experiment 03 (SUCCESS) currently contributes a nonzero standard SPL; failed episodes are S=0 regardless of L.
